events.title: Battle of Binh Le Nguyen
events.description: The opening battle of the first resistance war against the Mongol-Yuan army. King Tran Thai Tong directly commanded the Dai Viet army to block and attack the Mongol army led by Ngot Luong Hop Thai. Despite having to retreat to preserve forces, the battle wore down the enemy's strength.

events.title: Nguyen Danh Phuong Uprising
events.description: Nguyen Danh Phuong (Quan Heo) gathered peasants to rise up against the Le - Trinh administration, building a solid base in the Tam Dao mountainous region (Doc Ton, Ngoc Thanh). The uprising lasted for more than 10 years, controlling a vast area in Son Tay, Thai Nguyen, and Tuyen Quang.

events.title: Establishment of the Vinh Tuong Party Cell
events.description: The first Communist Party Cell of Vinh Yen Province (now Vinh Phuc) was established in Bich Chu Hamlet. This event marked a turning point in the local revolutionary movement under the leadership of the Party.

events.title: Seizing power in Vinh Yen provincial capital
events.description: The Viet Minh forces and the masses besieged, attacked, and captured the Vinh Yen Post and the Governor's Palace, seizing power for the people during the August General Uprising.

events.title: Khoan Bo Victory
events.description: Guerrillas and local soldiers organized an ambush on a French motorized convoy and infantry on Route 2 (the section passing through Khoan Bo slope). Our troops destroyed many European-African soldiers and military vehicles, breaking an offensive spearhead in the French Fall-Winter campaign.

events.title: Battle of Xuan Trach
events.description: Battalion 428 and local forces attacked and destroyed the Xuan Trach position, an important French outpost aimed at controlling the Lo River region. This victory expanded the Lap Thach - Song Lo free zone.

events.title: Battle of Vinh Yen (Tran Hung Dao Campaign)
events.description: One of the largest battles in the resistance war against the French in Northern Vietnam. Divisions 308 and 312, under the command of General Vo Nguyen Giap, engaged in fierce fighting with the mobile group of General De Lattre de Tassigny in the mountainous area north of Vinh Yen.

events.title: Resolution 68 (Khoan ho - Khoan 10)
events.description: The Vinh Phuc Provincial Party Committee, chaired by Secretary Kim Ngoc, issued Resolution No. 68-NQ/TU on 'Several issues in agricultural labor management', initiating the household contract system. This was a breakthrough in economic thinking, serving as a precursor to Khoan 10 and the subsequent Doi Moi reform.

events.title: Shooting down of F-105D aircraft
events.description: The militia and self-defense forces of Tien Chau Commune coordinated with air defense troops to shoot down a US F-105D 'Thunderchief' aircraft as they were attacking vital transportation routes through the area.

events.title: Establishment of Vinh Phu Province
events.description: The Standing Committee of the National Assembly issued Resolution No. 504-NQ/TVQH merging the two provinces of Vinh Phuc and Phu Tho into Vinh Phu Province to concentrate resources for the resistance war against the US and the building of socialism.

events.title: Re-establishment of Vinh Phuc Province
events.description: At its 10th session, the 9th National Assembly passed a Resolution to split Vinh Phu Province back into two provinces, Vinh Phuc and Phu Tho. Vinh Phuc Province officially resumed operations on January 1, 1997.
